summary: Monday faces a weak US lead and fresh Hormuz tanker risk, set against record foreign buying and a firmer rupee, in a holiday-shortened week that opens with monthly expiry.

detail.tone: A look-ahead to Monday 23 November, the only session before Tuesday's holiday. A quiet Sunday afternoon; the only fresh item is tanker trouble near Hormuz, which adds a little caution on crude.
